reliability.rationale: The selected two-memory correction reduces June equal-authority MAE to283.8716MW from323.8625MW for48h residual and464.3410MW for official forecasts, winning50/53 authority groups. Fixed temporal contract and no target-hour balance variables avoid an accounting identity.

mechanism.rationale: Recent/weekly forecast residuals plausibly encode persistent bias, but are not electricity-conservation laws. Revisions and common weather can generate correlation; coefficients do not identify a causal forecasting mechanism.

novelty.rationale: Prior physical/statistical families are disclosed. This bounded literature check does not certify new laws or exhaustive novelty.

impact.rationale: No independent intervention, deployment-cost study or external experimental replication.
